How it works

Prep like a brigade, not a cram

  1. 1

    Set your exam date

    Your countdown and study plan are built from it, so every day has a clear prep list.

  2. 2

    Work the stations

    Drill the big stations first. Meats and fish alone carry 31 of the 150 questions.

  3. 3

    Run a full service

    Once a week, sit a timed simulation. Results show you station by station where you stand.

  4. 4

    Close the gaps

    Your mistake notebook and weak-spot training turn every wrong answer into the next drill.
